description: This file defines a Java class 'ProcessSnapshotParser' which is responsible for parsing process snapshots from VM traces. It extracts process IDs, timestamps, cmd lines, and thread information from textual process dump data.

classes.name: ProcessSnapshotParser
classes.description: A parser for processing and extracting information from VM trace process snapshots.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a sequence of lines representing process snapshot data to produce a ProcessSnapshot object containing process details and thread information.
